text:
Ella: Quick design review — dropped a Figma prototype and 30s walkthrough for the Prompt Sets & Evals scorecard updates. Focus areas: compact row mode, regression-diff UI, and bulk-approve flow + audit copy. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/ps-evals-scorecard (comments open).

Omar: Thanks! Two quick governance Qs: 1) If someone uses Bulk Approve, do we force a rationale? 2) Do we expose the audit log via API or only console? Need to know for backend scope.

Sasha: UI thoughts: compact rows look much cleaner in dense lists, but we lose long-prompt visibility. Proposal: default to compact, with a per-row expand chevron that reveals full prompt and the full diff. Add a global toggle "Compact mode" in the top bar and a keyboard shortcut `c`.

Sasha: Also suggests lazy-loading diffs to avoid rendering heavy diffs for long lists — only fetch diffs when user expands a row or turns on "Show diffs" for the page.

James: Accessibility nits: keyboard navigation needs to be explicit — up/down to move between rows, Enter/Space to expand, and Esc to close diffs. Diff toggle must have aria-expanded + aria-controls and updates should be announced to screen readers. Example:
```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="diff-123" aria-label="Toggle diff for test case 123">▸</button>
```

James: Also ran a quick color check — the muted token tag uses #9aa0a6 on white and fails AA for 14px. Recommend #6b7280 or increase font-weight.

DesignBot: Automated regression scan on the prototype detected a potential focus order break when bulk approve modal opens (focus lands on modal background in Safari). It logged: `focus-trap-mismatch: modal-init-focus-null`.

Ella: Good catch — modal focus must land on the primary CTA and trap. Also microcopy question: what should the bulk action button text be? Options: "Approve selected (add reason)" vs "Approve all passed". I prefer explicit "Approve selected — reason required" to make audit obvious.

Omar: Agreed on required reason. Backend: we need a `review_reason` string on bulk action with user id and timestamp. We should expose an endpoint POST /audits/bulk_review that returns an audit_id to link to UI. I'll add to the sprint.
text_2:
Sasha: Quick UX edge: if parent folder selects children, we need to show a tri-state checkbox and a small counter like "12 selected". Also support Shift+click for range selection.

Sasha: For keyboard shortcuts — propose: `v` to open details view, `a` to approve (when focus is on row), `r` to request review. We'll document these in a help tooltip.

James: On completion feedback: screen reader should announce "12 tests approved" and move focus to the audit link that opens the audit trail for those tests. Ensure that the success toast is accessible via role=alert.

Ella: UX copy suggestions for statuses: use concise labels — "Pass", "Needs review", "Regression". For diffs, label them as "Regression diff (model vX ► vY)" so it's clear which comparison is being shown.

Omar: Backend note — store diff metadata (from_model, to_model, diff_hash) and surface `diff_hash` in the audit log so we can tie UI diffs to reproducible artifacts.

Sasha: I'll prototype the compact toggle + row expand today and include the keyboard map. I'll also try to add a small inline preview so users can skim prompts without expanding full diff.

James: I'll run a focused a11y pass on the dev branch once Sasha's PR is up (particularly focus traps, roles, aria labels, and contrast).

Ella: Plan: quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm copy and keyboard interactions. Action items: Sasha — keyboard + compact mode prototype; James — a11y audit on dev; Omar — backend audit endpoint & payload schema. I'll update the Figma with new copy changes after sync.

Omar: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Ping me here when PR is ready, I can help test keyboard flows. :white_check_mark:

James: I'll add the contrast recommended hexes to the style tokens PR.

Ella: Thanks everyone — wrapping this up, will post updated mocks after our sync. :sparkles:
